findings.body:
chunk 2/2:

New evidence beyond the previous cleanup/service-launch finding: this guide identifies `job_runs` as terminal evidence, and the same claim appears in its data table at line 242 and `10-shared-domain.md:218`. However, `apps/core/src/adapters/storage/postgres/repositories/canonical-job-run-insert.postgres.ts:35` inserts scheduler runs into `agentRunsPostgres`, and `canonical-job-repository.postgres.ts:483–490` writes terminal status and summaries to that same `agent_runs` table. Production references to `jobRunsPostgres` are limited to its schema declaration and the async-task foreign key. These descriptions direct readers to an unwritten table when investigating execution outcomes. Correct all three current-guide descriptions and repeat source verification to meet the code-checked documentation requirement.
